# netbox_front_port_template (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/frontporttemplate/):

> A front port template describes a front port that is created on every device of a device type or module type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_front_port_template" "example" {
  name           = "example"
  device_type_id = netbox_device_type.example.id
  type           = "8p8c"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) {module} is accepted as a substitution for the module bay position when attached to a module type.
- `type` (String) One of [8p8c, 8p6c, 8p4c, 8p2c, 6p6c, 6p4c, 6p2c, 4p4c, 4p2c, gg45, tera-4p, tera-2p, tera-1p, 110-punch, bnc, f, n, mrj21, fc, fc-pc, fc-upc, fc-apc, lc, lc-pc, lc-upc, lc-apc, mu, mu-pc, mu-upc, mu-apc, lsh, lsh-pc, lsh-upc, lsh-apc, lx5, lx5-pc, lx5-upc, lx5-apc, mpo, mtrj, sc, sc-pc, sc-upc, sc-apc, st, cs, sn, mdc, sma-905, sma-906, urm-p2, urm-p4, urm-p8, splice, usb-a, usb-b, usb-c, usb-mini-a, usb-mini-b, usb-micro-a, usb-micro-b, usb-micro-ab, other].

### Optional

- `color_hex` (String) The color hex of the front port template.
- `description` (String) A description of the front port template.
- `device_type_id` (Number) The ID of the device type associated with the front port template.
- `label` (String) Physical label.
- `module_type_id` (Number) The ID of the module type associated with the front port template.
- `positions` (Number) The positions of the front port template.
- `rear_port_id` (Number) ID of the rear port template this port is mapped to. Use `rear_ports` to map more than one position. Conflicts with `rear_ports`.
- `rear_port_position` (Number) The rear port position of the front port template.
- `rear_ports` (Attributes List) The ports and positions this port is mapped to. Needs NetBox 4.5 or newer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rear_ports))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--rear_ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rear_ports`

Required:

- `position` (Number) Position on this port.
- `rear_port_id` (Number)

Optional:

- `rear_port_position` (Number) Position on the other port. Defaults to `1`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_front_port_template.example 1
```
